options.label: Stale env_* in Claude.ai dropdown
options.description: Get rid of the duplicate/zombie entries shown in the Remote Control dropdown. These live on Claude.ai's side — I'd need to check whether there's a CLI/API to deregister them, otherwise it's manual via the gear icon next to each row.

options.label: Local Claude Code session state
options.description: Wipe local Claude Code session/cache state on this Mac (e.g. ~/.claude logs, session files). Won't touch the cloud dropdown.

options.description: Kick the supervisor so all 4 mm-* servers get fresh processes (will create *new* env IDs on Claude.ai — i.e. make the dropdown worse, not better). Only do this if you have a different reason.

options.label: Stop creating new env IDs on every restart
options.description: Investigate whether `claude remote-control` can persist/reuse an env ID across restarts so the supervisor stops polluting the dropdown each launchd respawn. Research first, then propose a fix.

transcript_tail.text:
The supervisor side is healthy — only the 4 allowlisted servers are running. The duplicates and extras in the dropdown (`job-search`, `portfolio`, `fin-export`, `dstrader-aws`, plus the second copies of dstrader / FamilyFund / dev / claude-remote-control) are stale registrations on the Claude.ai side, not local.

Let me check what the supervisor / `claude remote-control` does at start/stop to understand whether old registrations are getting cleaned up.

Found the root cause first, then I'll address your follow-up.

**Why the dropdown is messy:** every time `claude remote-control --name mm-X` starts, it registers a *brand-new* `env_*` ID with Claude.ai. The supervisor has been relaunched several times today, and each relaunch leaves the old `env_*` IDs orphaned but still listed in the dropdown (showing "0 of 32" because their process is gone).
